qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace the negative-authority analysis edge with a positively authoritative edge carrying one complete executable policy capsule originated by the first call, while retaining direct common-input visibility for terminal obligation discharge.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Unified constructive provenance should reduce late synthesis reversals, alter phase-shift responsiveness, and improve coherence between object-oriented and byte-oriented evidence.

qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The incumbent's veto-first analysis can anchor final synthesis to an exclusion-shaped space while deferring every positive commitment, creating decision inertia and late inconsistency.

structural_mutation.before: A non-policy analysis edge carries binding exclusions, while the terminal call retains de novo constructive authority.
structural_mutation.factor: positive constructive sovereignty of the sole lineage edge
structural_mutation.why_structural: The single edge changes from veto-bearing analysis to policy-bearing constructive custody, consequently relocating decision authority and executable commitment timing.
